STEP 1 - Scene: A salad-style plate with roasted/grilled chicken pieces, a bed of arugula (rocket) with chickpeas or similar legumes, a broccoli floret, and chili slivers, dressed with a light sauce.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White rectangular-ish dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Arugula/rocket leaves (large portion, left side)
- Grilled chicken pieces with mustard/seed crust (upper right)
- Broccoli floret with stem (bottom center)
- Chickpeas (few, scattered)
- Dressing/sauce (light, on leaves)
- Chili slivers (tiny)

- Arugula: ~28% = 148 cm^2
- Chicken: ~17% = 90 cm^2
- Broccoli: ~8% = 42 cm^2

- Dressing/chili: ~1% = 5 cm^2
Total covered ≈ 55%, consistent with the visible plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Arugula: 148 cm^2 x 3 cm = 444 ml
- Chicken: 90 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 135 ml
- Broccoli: 42 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 105 ml
- Chickpeas: 5 cm^2 x 1 cm = 5 ml
- Dressing: 5 cm^2 x 0.3 cm = 2 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Arugula: 444 x 0.15 = 67 g
- Chicken: 135 x 0.95 = 128 g
- Broccoli: 105 x 0.55 = 58 g

- Dressing (oil-based, ~0.9 g/ml): 2 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Arugula: 67 g x 25 kcal/100g = 17 kcal
- Chicken (cooked, skin/crust): 128 g x 190 kcal/100g = 243 kcal
- Broccoli: 58 g x 34 kcal/100g = 20 kcal
- Chickpeas: 4 g x 160 kcal/100g = 6 kcal
- Dressing: 2 g x 600 kcal/100g = 12 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 259 g and ≈ 298 kcal. This fits a single modest salad-with-chicken plate that is only about half covered, so it is plausible and not an oversized serving.
